title: Use Your Good Word
tagline: Biblical worldview party game for phones + TV!
description: A Christian edition of Use Your Words & Jackbox! Cast the stage to a TV or play right on your phones: write headlines for The Jerusalem Gazette, caption Bible scenes, bluff your family in Truth or Bluff, dodge the Scribe's Trap, and battle for 2x points in Survey Says — complete with a live Game-Show Announcer voice!
how_to: Open on your phone in Jarvis (or cast /tv to a big screen) and join the 4-letter Family Room Code!
Write your funniest or wisest answer for Blank-O-Matic, The Jerusalem Gazette, and Sub the Scroll — or play the Scribe's Decoy (+500 pts/vote).
In Truth or Bluff, write a believable fake answer to fool the room (+750 pts) and vote for the real Scriptural truth (+1,000 pts).
Beware the Scribe's Trap (-250 pts), and go all-in during Round 7's Double-Point Survey Says Finale!
